text.en: Pet owners describe Rima as a patient, perceptive, and deeply supportive behaviourist across North West London. First-time dog owners and rescue handlers note that she explains canine body language clearly without judgement. Reviews emphasize that she boosts owners' confidence by breaking training steps into practical routines and checking in regularly between sessions.

title.en: Visible progress in lead and recall

text.en: Handlers report substantial improvements in managing leash pulling, outdoor reactivity, and reliable emergency recall on walks. Clients highlight that structured exercises turn overwhelmed puppies and reactive rescues into calm, attentive companions. Reviewers value the practical mental stimulation games and written coaching notes provided following each appointment.

Reviewers note that puppies and reactive rescue dogs form an immediate bond with Rima during training sessions. Clients appreciate her gentle, positive reinforcement methods, which keep dogs engaged and eager to learn without unnecessary stress. Owners of different breeds, including cockapoos and terriers, praise her thoughtful handling of canine anxiety.

q.en: Does Even Better Dogs assist with leash reactivity and recall?

a.en: Yes, clients report notable success in reducing reactivity on walks and teaching reliable name response and recall.

q.en: Are written training notes provided after sessions?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention receiving comprehensive recap notes and practical exercises to practice at home after each consultation.

q.en: Does the trainer work with first-time puppy owners?

a.en: Yes, pet parents highlight multi-session puppy packages that provide foundational guidance on routines, commands, and confidence.

q.en: What training methodology is applied during coaching?

a.en: Reviews highlight positive reinforcement techniques and mental stimulation games designed to build calm canine behaviour.
